blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines–Ateneo’s Shawn Tuano has been handed a one-game suspension after incurring his second unsportsmanlike foul in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament. Tuano will serve his suspension on Wednesday, when the Blue Eagles face the University of the East in their final game of the Season 89 at Mall of Asia Arena. His second unsportsmanlike foul came with 21 seconds left in the fourth quarter of Ateneo’s loss to University of Santo Tomas on Sunday.
